eu5ab_gui_delete_template_slot_1 = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		# A deleted template must not leave locations pointing at a reusable slot.
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot var:eu5ab_template_slot = 1 }
			eu5ab_clear_location_policy = yes
		}
		# Reset the reusable slot through the shared editor path without duplicating hundreds of fields here.
		eu5ab_load_new_template_into_editor = yes
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_1_and_refresh_budget = yes
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_1_saved
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_1_exists
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_1_paused
		remove_variable = eu5ab_active_template_slot
		eu5ab_select_first_player_template = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_toggle_template_slot_1_paused = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_tpl_1_paused }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_1_paused
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_tpl_1_paused value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_delete_template_slot_3 = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		# A deleted template must not leave locations pointing at a reusable slot.
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot var:eu5ab_template_slot = 3 }
			eu5ab_clear_location_policy = yes
		}
		# Reset the reusable slot through the shared editor path without duplicating hundreds of fields here.
		eu5ab_load_new_template_into_editor = yes
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_3_and_refresh_budget = yes
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_3_saved
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_3_exists
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_3_paused
		remove_variable = eu5ab_active_template_slot
		eu5ab_select_first_player_template = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_toggle_template_slot_3_paused = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_tpl_3_paused }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_3_paused
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_tpl_3_paused value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

	}
}

eu5ab_gui_delete_template_slot_5 = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		# A deleted template must not leave locations pointing at a reusable slot.
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot var:eu5ab_template_slot = 5 }
			eu5ab_clear_location_policy = yes
		}
		# Reset the reusable slot through the shared editor path without duplicating hundreds of fields here.
		eu5ab_load_new_template_into_editor = yes
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_5_and_refresh_budget = yes
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_5_saved
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_5_exists
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_5_paused
		remove_variable = eu5ab_active_template_slot
		eu5ab_select_first_player_template = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_toggle_template_slot_5_paused = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_tpl_5_paused }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_5_paused
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_tpl_5_paused value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

	}
}

eu5ab_gui_delete_template_slot_7 = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		# A deleted template must not leave locations pointing at a reusable slot.
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot var:eu5ab_template_slot = 7 }
			eu5ab_clear_location_policy = yes
		}
		# Reset the reusable slot through the shared editor path without duplicating hundreds of fields here.
		eu5ab_load_new_template_into_editor = yes
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_7_and_refresh_budget = yes
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_7_saved
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_7_exists
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_7_paused
		remove_variable = eu5ab_active_template_slot
		eu5ab_select_first_player_template = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_toggle_template_slot_7_paused = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_tpl_7_paused }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_7_paused
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_tpl_7_paused value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }

	effect = {
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_9_and_refresh_budget = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_delete_template_slot_9 = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		# A deleted template must not leave locations pointing at a reusable slot.
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot var:eu5ab_template_slot = 9 }
			eu5ab_clear_location_policy = yes
		}
		# Reset the reusable slot through the shared editor path without duplicating hundreds of fields here.
		eu5ab_load_new_template_into_editor = yes
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_9_and_refresh_budget = yes
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_9_saved
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_9_exists
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_9_paused
		remove_variable = eu5ab_active_template_slot
		eu5ab_select_first_player_template = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_toggle_template_slot_9_paused = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_tpl_9_paused }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_9_paused
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_tpl_9_paused value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_copy_active_template_to_slot_11 = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_11_and_refresh_budget = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_delete_template_slot_11 = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		# A deleted template must not leave locations pointing at a reusable slot.
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot var:eu5ab_template_slot = 11 }
			eu5ab_clear_location_policy = yes
		}
		# Reset the reusable slot through the shared editor path without duplicating hundreds of fields here.
		eu5ab_load_new_template_into_editor = yes
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_11_and_refresh_budget = yes
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_11_saved
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_11_exists
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_11_paused
		remove_variable = eu5ab_active_template_slot
		eu5ab_select_first_player_template = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_toggle_template_slot_11_paused = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_tpl_11_paused }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_11_paused
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_tpl_11_paused value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

	}
}

eu5ab_gui_delete_template_slot_13 = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		# A deleted template must not leave locations pointing at a reusable slot.
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot var:eu5ab_template_slot = 13 }
			eu5ab_clear_location_policy = yes
		}
		# Reset the reusable slot through the shared editor path without duplicating hundreds of fields here.
		eu5ab_load_new_template_into_editor = yes
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_13_and_refresh_budget = yes
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_13_saved
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_13_exists
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_13_paused
		remove_variable = eu5ab_active_template_slot
		eu5ab_select_first_player_template = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_toggle_template_slot_13_paused = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_tpl_13_paused }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_13_paused
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_tpl_13_paused value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_edit_name_id value = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_edit_name_selected value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_tpl_15_saved value = 1 }

eu5ab_gui_copy_active_template_to_slot_15 = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_15_and_refresh_budget = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_delete_template_slot_15 = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		# A deleted template must not leave locations pointing at a reusable slot.
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot var:eu5ab_template_slot = 15 }
			eu5ab_clear_location_policy = yes
		}
		# Reset the reusable slot through the shared editor path without duplicating hundreds of fields here.
		eu5ab_load_new_template_into_editor = yes
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_15_and_refresh_budget = yes
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_15_saved
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_15_exists
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_15_paused
		remove_variable = eu5ab_active_template_slot
		eu5ab_select_first_player_template = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_toggle_template_slot_15_paused = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_tpl_15_paused }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_15_paused
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_tpl_15_paused value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_copy_active_template_to_slot_17 = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_17_and_refresh_budget = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_delete_template_slot_17 = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		# A deleted template must not leave locations pointing at a reusable slot.
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot var:eu5ab_template_slot = 17 }
			eu5ab_clear_location_policy = yes
		}
		# Reset the reusable slot through the shared editor path without duplicating hundreds of fields here.
		eu5ab_load_new_template_into_editor = yes
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_17_and_refresh_budget = yes
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_17_saved
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_17_exists
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_17_paused
		remove_variable = eu5ab_active_template_slot
		eu5ab_select_first_player_template = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_toggle_template_slot_17_paused = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_tpl_17_paused }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_17_paused
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_tpl_17_paused value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_copy_active_template_to_slot_19 = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }

	effect = {
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_19_and_refresh_budget = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_delete_template_slot_19 = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		# A deleted template must not leave locations pointing at a reusable slot.
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot var:eu5ab_template_slot = 19 }
			eu5ab_clear_location_policy = yes
		}
		# Reset the reusable slot through the shared editor path without duplicating hundreds of fields here.
		eu5ab_load_new_template_into_editor = yes
		eu5ab_commit_template_editor_to_slot_19_and_refresh_budget = yes
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_19_saved
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_19_exists
		remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_19_paused
		remove_variable = eu5ab_active_template_slot
		eu5ab_select_first_player_template = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_toggle_template_slot_19_paused = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_tpl_19_paused }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_tpl_19_paused
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_tpl_19_paused value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = { }
}

		}

eu5ab_gui_clear_location_template = {
	scope = country
	saved_scopes = { target_location }
	is_shown = {
		scope:target_location ?= {
		has_owner = yes
		owner ?= { is_human = yes }
		has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id
		}
	}
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		scope:target_location ?= {
		eu5ab_clear_location_policy = yes
		}
		eu5ab_prepare_template_scope_view = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_clear_current_template_scope = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { var:eu5ab_scope_location_count > 0 }
	effect = {
		every_owned_location = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					root = { var:eu5ab_scope_view_mode = 1 }
					has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot
					var:eu5ab_template_slot = root.var:eu5ab_scope_view_value
				}
				eu5ab_clear_location_policy = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					root = { var:eu5ab_scope_view_mode = 2 }
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot }
					has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id
					var:eu5ab_policy_id = root.var:eu5ab_scope_view_value
				}
				eu5ab_clear_location_policy = yes
			}
		}
		eu5ab_prepare_template_scope_view = yes
	}
}

# Hidden actual-value bridge and queue coordinator.
eu5ab_gui_queue_should_validate = {
	is_shown = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_active NOT = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_fire } }
}

eu5ab_gui_queue_phase_1_should_validate = {
	is_shown = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_active NOT = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_fire } var:eu5ab_q_phase = 1 }
}

eu5ab_gui_queue_phase_2_should_validate = {
	is_shown = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_active NOT = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_fire } var:eu5ab_q_phase = 2 }
}

eu5ab_gui_queue_phase_3_should_validate = {
	is_shown = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_active NOT = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_fire } var:eu5ab_q_phase = 3 }

	is_shown = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_active NOT = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_fire } var:eu5ab_q_phase = 4 }
}

	is_shown = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_active NOT = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_fire } var:eu5ab_q_phase = 5 }

	is_shown = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_active NOT = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_fire } var:eu5ab_q_phase = 7 }
}

}

eu5ab_gui_queue_should_fire = {
	is_shown = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_active exists = var:eu5ab_q_fire }
}

eu5ab_gui_queue_try_candidate = {
	saved_scopes = { eu5ab_candidate_building eu5ab_engine_country eu5ab_engine_cost eu5ab_engine_income eu5ab_engine_profit eu5ab_engine_can_build }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active has_variable = eu5ab_q_phase NOT = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_fire } }
				OR = {
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 1 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 2 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_2_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 3 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_3_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 4 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_4_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 5 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_5_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 6 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_6_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 7 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_7_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 8 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_8_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
				}
				NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_done_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
			}
			add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_done_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_processed add = 1 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_engine_probes add = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_location_approved }
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_action_taken }
					NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_failed_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
					eu5ab_engine_candidate_in_current_priority_phase = yes
					num_civil_constructions < 1
					scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
						var:eu5ab_q_approved < {
							value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota
							subtract = var:eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick
						}
					}
					scope:eu5ab_engine_can_build = yes
					eu5ab_engine_candidate_economically_sound = yes
					eu5ab_engine_candidate_has_actual_budget = yes
					eu5ab_engine_candidate_keeps_actual_cash_reserve = yes
					eu5ab_engine_construction_materials_available = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_uses_emergency_override = yes }
					set_variable = eu5ab_q_approved_emergency_override
				}
				else = { remove_variable = eu5ab_q_approved_emergency_override }
				eu5ab_approve_engine_candidate = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { scope:eu5ab_engine_can_build = yes } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_vanilla add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_economically_sound = yes } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_engine_economics add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_engine_construction_materials_available = yes } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_construction_materials add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_has_actual_budget = yes } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_budget add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_keeps_actual_cash_reserve = yes } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_cash add = 1 } }
			}
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_queue_try_rgo = {
	saved_scopes = { eu5ab_engine_country }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active has_variable = eu5ab_q_phase NOT = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_fire } }
				OR = {
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 1 scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_rgo_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 2 scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_2_rgo_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 3 scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_3_rgo_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 4 scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_4_rgo_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 5 scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_5_rgo_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 6 scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_6_rgo_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 7 scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_7_rgo_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } }
					AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase = 8 scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_8_rgo_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } }
				}
				NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_done_rgo }
			}
			set_variable = eu5ab_q_done_rgo
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_processed add = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_action_taken }
					eu5ab_rgo_in_current_priority_phase = yes
				}
				eu5ab_try_construct_rgo_need = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_queue_probe_approved = {
	saved_scopes = { eu5ab_candidate_building eu5ab_engine_country }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_fire } } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_seen_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_seen_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
			scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_seen add = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_queue_sync_check = {
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = eu5ab_q_active
				has_variable = eu5ab_q_processed
				has_variable = eu5ab_q_expected
				has_variable = eu5ab_q_approved
				has_variable = eu5ab_q_seen
				has_variable = eu5ab_q_phase
				has_variable = eu5ab_q_progress_last
				has_variable = eu5ab_q_stall_rounds
				has_variable = eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick
				has_variable = eu5ab_monthly_build_quota
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:eu5ab_q_processed >= { value = var:eu5ab_q_expected } }
				if = {
					limit = { var:eu5ab_q_approved <= 0 }
					eu5ab_advance_engine_priority_phase = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:eu5ab_q_seen >= { value = var:eu5ab_q_approved } }
					set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_fire value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_queue_state value = 3 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_fire } }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_progress_now value = var:eu5ab_q_processed }
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_progress_now add = var:eu5ab_q_seen }
				if = {
					limit = { var:eu5ab_q_progress_now > { value = var:eu5ab_q_progress_last } }
					set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_progress_last value = var:eu5ab_q_progress_now }
					set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_stall_rounds value = 0 }
				}
				else = {
					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_stall_rounds add = 1 }
					if = {
						limit = { var:eu5ab_q_stall_rounds >= 12 }
						change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_queue_recoveries add = 1 }
						set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_queue_state value = 5 }
						eu5ab_finish_engine_candidate_queue = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_queue_confirm_candidate = {
	saved_scopes = { eu5ab_candidate_building }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { owner = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active has_variable = eu5ab_q_fire } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_approved_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_confirmed_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } }
			eu5ab_confirm_engine_candidate = yes
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_gui_queue_confirm_sync = {
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = eu5ab_q_active
				has_variable = eu5ab_q_confirmed
				has_variable = eu5ab_q_approved
				has_variable = eu5ab_q_confirm_stall_rounds
				has_variable = eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick
				has_variable = eu5ab_monthly_build_quota
			}
			if = {
				limit = { var:eu5ab_q_confirmed >= { value = var:eu5ab_q_approved } }
				if = {
					limit = { var:eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick < { value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota } has_variable = eu5ab_q_retry_phase }
					# Only a native construction rejection needs the same phase again;
					# an all-success round has already exhausted its routed candidates.
					eu5ab_restart_engine_priority_phase = yes
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { var:eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick < { value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota } }
					eu5ab_advance_engine_priority_phase = yes
				}
				else = { eu5ab_finish_engine_candidate_queue = yes }
			}
			else = {
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_confirm_stall_rounds add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:eu5ab_q_confirm_stall_rounds >= 12 }
					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_queue_recoveries add = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_queue_state value = 5 }
					eu5ab_finish_engine_candidate_queue = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
